cohort: Pregnant women with untreated, antibody negative subclinical hypothyroidism and a control group of euthyroid pregnant women
finding: Pregnant women with untreated, antibody negative subclinical hypothyroidism had an increased risk of pregnancy loss, impaired glucose tolerance, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, neonatal intensive care unit admission, placenta previa, and cesarean delivery compared to euthyroid pregnant women.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was higher in the subclinical hypothyroidism group (OR 1.263; 95% CI 1.091-1.462; P = 0.002).
